[218] UniLatent: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Latent Observation Alignment cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yufei Ding, Yi Du, Weiduo Yuan, Hao Jiang, Dylan Goetting

TL;DR: 论文提出 UniLatent 跨具身迁移框架，通过在仿真中渲染源-目标机器人配对观测，将源视觉编码器对齐到冻结的目标编码器，从而在共享潜空间中减小具身差异导致的观察差距。对齐后，源机器人演示训练的策略可直接在目标机器人观测上运行，无需像素级图像翻译。

Details

Motivation: 机器人数据采集成本高且通常绑定特定具身，难以在不同几何、外观和运动学的机器人之间复用演示；论文旨在解决跨具身迁移中的观察差距问题。

Result: 在三个仿真任务和两个目标机械臂上，UniLatent 达到最高 93% 的零样本成功率，平均超过最强像素翻译基线 30 多个百分点；在真实 xArm-to-Franka 迁移中，每个任务仅用 10 个目标演示微调即可实现 30 次 rollout 中 27 次成功。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是通过仿真配对观测将源视觉编码器对齐到冻结目标编码器，在潜空间实现跨具身观察对齐而无需像素级翻译；客观来看，其可借鉴之处在于利用冻结目标编码器和仿真配对数据降低目标域数据需求，并将跨具身迁移从像素翻译转为潜空间对齐。

Abstract: Robot datasets are costly to collect and are usually tied to a specific embodiment, making it difficult to reuse demonstrations across robots with different geometry, appearance, and kinematics. We introduce UniLatent, a cross-embodiment transfer framework that reduces the embodiment-induced observation gap in a shared latent space. UniLatent renders paired source-target robot observations in simulation and aligns a source visual encoder to a frozen target encoder. A policy trained on encoded source demonstrations can then run directly on target observations, with no pixel-level image translation. Across three simulation tasks and two target robot arms, UniLatent reaches up to 93% zero-shot success, exceeding the strongest pixel-translation baseline by over 30 points on average. In real-world xArm-to-Franka transfer, fine-tuning with only 10 target demonstrations per task yields 27/30 successful rollouts. Code, videos and data are available at https://selina2023.github.io/unilatent/.

[219] BATCH: Behavior Alignment for Cross-Embodiment Learning from Humans cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Zeyi Liu, Shuran Song

TL;DR: 论文提出BATCH，一个面向从人类演示学习机器人操作的跨具身学习框架。它通过自监督时序表示与循环一致性目标，在无需人工标注的情况下建立人类与机器人行为对应，并在自回归视频-动作扩散模型中结合行为对齐协同训练和人类到机器人风格迁移。实验表明该方法能提升真实操作任务中对未见任务配置的泛化能力。

Details

Motivation: 人类演示数据多样且可扩展，但直接用于机器人学习会受到具身形态、视角、动作空间和时间结构差异的影响。论文旨在显式对齐人类与机器人行为，从而更有效地实现跨具身知识迁移。

Result: 在真实世界操作任务上，BATCH相比使用未对齐数据和先前跨具身基线，提升了对未见任务配置的泛化能力；引入风格迁移目标还能带来额外增益。

Insight: 创新点在于用循环一致性自监督学习跨具身时序对应，无需人工标注，并将行为对齐协同训练与人类到机器人风格迁移统一到视频-动作扩散模型中。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是显式行为对齐机制与无标注跨具身对应构建，能增强人类演示到机器人策略的迁移效果。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation data, but leveraging them for robot learning remains challenging due to differences in embodiment, viewpoint, action spaces, and temporal structure. We introduce BATCH, a cross-embodiment learning framework that explicitly aligns human and robot behaviors. BATCH learns self-supervised temporal representations with a cycle-consistency objective to establish cross-embodiment correspondences without manual annotation. We further introduce two complementary training objectives that leverage these correspondences within an autoregressive videoaction diffusion model: behavior-aligned co-training and human-to-robot style transfer. On real-world manipulation tasks, BATCH improves generalization to unseen task configurations compared with training on unaligned data and prior cross-embodiment baselines, with additional gains from the style-transfer objective. Our results demonstrate that explicit behavior alignment enables more effective transfer from human demonstrations to robot policies.

[220] HSGNav: Hypothesis Scene Graphs for Multi-Scale Lifelong Navigation under Object Relocation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Chen Chen, Qing Sun, Ningbo Gu

TL;DR: 论文面向家庭辅助机器人在物体被移动场景下的多尺度终身导航任务，提出假设场景图HSG，将稳定的3D家具实体与可修正的表面物体假设分离表示，并基于此构建HSGNav，通过按目标尺度检索、探索补充表面观测和验证失效矛盾假设来实现查找与重查找。论文还提出FAROS-Bench，用于评估中途物体重定位和多尺度目标搜索。

Details

Motivation: 真实家庭中物体常被人在不同表面间移动，机器人需要反复定位从大家具到桌面小物体的多尺度目标；统一将不同尺度检测实例化为3D物体会对小物体脆弱，且缺乏物体状态验证会导致场景变化后保留过期记忆。

Result: 实验表明HSGNav在GOAT-Bench上表现有竞争力，并在新提出的FAROS-Bench上显著优于先前方法。

Insight: 核心创新是将持久家具实体与可修正表面物体假设分层建模，保留小物体视觉证据而无需独立物体几何，并支持局部修正而不重建稳定实体拓扑；同时引入包含中途重定位和多尺度查找目标的FAROS-Bench，弥补现有终身导航基准对记忆失效和多尺度搜索覆盖不足的问题。

Abstract: In real homes, assistive robots must repeatedly locate targets from large furniture to tiny tabletop items, as people move objects between household surfaces. Uniformly instantiating detections at different scales as 3D objects can be brittle for small on-surface items; without explicit object-state validation, stale entries may persist after scene changes. Our key insight is to separate persistent 3D furniture entities from revisable surface-object hypotheses, retaining their visual evidence without requiring independent object geometry. We formalize this design as the Hypothesis Scene Graph (HSG), which preserves small-object evidence and supports local revision without rebuilding the stable entity topology. Building on HSG, HSGNav uses this separation for multi-scale lifelong navigation: retrieval selects entity or hypothesis evidence according to target scale, exploration acquires additional surface observations, and verification confirms target presence or invalidates contradicted hypothesis records. Because existing lifelong benchmarks such as GOAT-Bench rarely require mid-episode memory invalidation or multi-scale search, we introduce FAROS-Bench (Find And Re-find Objects across Scales) for mid-episode relocation of surface objects and multi-scale find goals. Experiments show that HSGNav performs competitively on GOAT-Bench while substantially outperforming prior methods on FAROS-Bench.

[221] Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.MAPDF

Chengyuan Ma, Shixiao Liang, Hangyu Li, Zheng Li, Hang Zhou

TL;DR: 论文提出一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的智能体框架，用于多智能体交通环境中的选择性协同感知。该方法通过混合架构结合传统目标检测、视觉语言盲区推理和物理几何约束模块，并利用思维链提示支持可解释的意图感知决策，再通过对话机制按需共享感知信息。作者在真实联网车辆城市交通数据上评估了四种先进VLM，验证了驾驶关键盲区识别和对话式感知共享的有效性。

Details

Motivation: 实时协同感知资源消耗大，难以大规模部署，因此需要仅在安全关键场景和关键遮挡对象出现时选择性执行。VLM适合动态不确定环境中的复杂推理，但需与稳定感知和真实可见性约束结合以可靠落地。

Result: 在真实城市交通联网车辆数据上，方法实现超过80%的驾驶关键盲区检测准确率和超过90%的对话驱动感知共享成功率，并比较了四种先进VLM的表现。

Abstract: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires continuous coordination of high-dimensional whole-body motion to realize task objectives. Following large-scale loco-manipulation pretraining, the policy achieves the highest overall success among compared policies on multi-task HumanoidArena (72.14%), competitive performance on SIMPLE, and 60% mean success across eight real-world tasks, with 678M parameters (92M trainable). Abstract: Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p<0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.

Abstract: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. Abstract: We study humanoid navigation across multiple destinations under long-horizon language instructions. This task is challenging because robots must maintain progress across successive goals while continuously producing natural, stable whole-body motion through confined spaces. However, task decomposition in existing methods does not by itself ensure progress throughout execution, while waypoint-based navigation does not guarantee natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. Our key idea is to organize navigation into three complementary roles operating at different time scales: a Brain for task reasoning, a Cerebellum for local motion generation, and a Brainstem for whole-body execution. We realize this idea in LHNav, an asynchronous system that uses progress and arrival feedback to coordinate navigation goals, VLA motion-token prediction, and whole-body control. To train the Cerebellum for natural, route-faithful motion, we develop a physics-grounded data engine that improves physical tracking of motion references along collision-aware routes and pairs the resulting demonstrations with rendered visual observations. Together, these designs allow task planning to proceed alongside continuous movement and extend single-goal navigation to successive destinations with natural, route-faithful whole-body motion. In simulation, our navigation VLA outperforms OmniNav and DualVLN in single-goal success and motion smoothness, with fewer collisions and falls. Using a VLA trained only on single-goal demonstrations, LHNav achieves a 75.56% success rate on long-horizon navigation tasks. Deployment on the Unitree G1 further demonstrates single-goal navigation and zero-shot long-horizon task execution in real-world environments, including layouts with repositioned objects. Abstract: Physical intelligence requires embodied agents to ground language in observations and execute actions while retaining useful skills. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer a shared interface, but task-specific post-training often produces separate specialists. After acquiring task or suite experts, a shared student collects robot rollouts and queries the instruction-routed frozen teacher at each visited observation and intermediate ordinary differential equation (ODE) state. Detached per-flow-step transition targets supervise valid action chunks through a masked local matching loss; an optional reference-policy term supports retention on other tasks. Starting from one trajectory per LIBERO task, VLA-MOPD raises mean success-once from 75.4% to 98.9%, compared with 98.15% for endpoint action distillation. It improves mean RoboTwin 2.0 success from 73.0% to 89.3%; on a Piper robot, two consolidation rounds improve average success from 70.0% to 90.0%. Abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. Abstract: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans highly heterogeneous input regimes, with sampling rates from approximately $10^{-5}$ to $10^6$ Hz, sequence lengths from $10^1$ to $10^6$ samples, and both single- and multi-channel inputs. Evaluations of current open-source and proprietary Audio LLMs (ALLMs) reveal limited zero-shot transfer to machine hearing. Supervised adaptation on machine-hearing data alone does not close this gap, suggesting that the challenge extends beyond data exposure to a systematic mismatch between existing audio front ends and machine-hearing inputs. To address this mismatch, we introduce MachEar, a lightweight encoder extension that complements the pretrained Audio LLM for machine-hearing inputs. The results show that MachEar equips a pretrained Audio LLM with stronger machine-hearing capabilities while largely preserving its existing audio understanding performance.

Details

Motivation: 说话头生成依赖精确的音视频对齐，易被滥用于多模态深度伪造，而有效音频保护方法仍不足；论文旨在通过破坏音频-视觉对齐来防止语音被用于恶意说话头生成。

Result: 在白盒和黑盒说话头模型上均持续降低唇同步，保持感知音频质量；在真实世界变换下仍有效，并可与基于图像的方法结合提供更强的多模态保护。

Insight: 创新点在于提出对齐层与表示层结合的多级解耦保护，并在STFT高能量区域约束扰动以提升鲁棒性，可选说话人级目标缓解TTS重合成绕过；客观看，其多粒度扰动设计和鲁棒约束具有借鉴意义。

Abstract: Talking-head generation models, which synthesize realistic facial animations from audio, are increasingly vulnerable to misuse in multimodal deepfake scenarios. Protecting such systems remains challenging, as talking-head models fundamentally rely on precise audio-visual alignment, while effective audio protection methods remain largely underexplored. In this work, we propose MUTE, an audio protection framework that uncouples the underlying audio-visual alignment through a multi-level strategy. Specifically, MUTE combines (1) Alignment-level Disruption, which directly perturbs cross-modal attention to disrupt structural alignment, and (2) Representation-level Degradation, which perturbs temporal audio embeddings to degrade their representations. To improve robustness, perturbations are constrained in the STFT domain to high-energy regions, making them resistant to post-processing, denoising, and adaptive attacks. An optional speaker-level objective further mitigates potential bypass via TTS-based resynthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MUTE consistently degrades lip synchronization across both white-box and black-box talking-head models while preserving perceptual audio quality. The proposed method remains effective under real-world transformations and can be combined with image-based approaches to provide stronger multimodal protection. The source code and project page are available at https://github.com/jindl465/MUTE.

cs.SE [Back]

[230] Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering cs.SE | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Hongcheng Gao, Weiheng Li, Yipeng Wei, Yu Lei, Shuo Sun

TL;DR: 论文提出 Micius-Flash，一个面向工程领域的 270 亿参数轻量级智能体模型，支持原生多模态输入、深度推理和 256K 上下文窗口。作者构建知识树驱动的数据飞轮，训练半导体知识推理、硬件编码、半导体多模态理解和智能体等专家模型，再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合为统一模型，并开发 Micius Harness 连接 EDA、KiCad 等工具与执行环境。

Details

Motivation: 面向半导体和硬件工程等专业场景，现有通用模型缺乏领域知识、工具使用和多步工程任务能力，论文旨在构建轻量级、可落地且具备智能体能力的工程专用模型。

Result: 在 20 多个数据集、约 1.5 万条记录上，硬件代码基准平均达 64.2%，比同规模基线高 15.0 分；半导体专用智能体基准达 62.4%，比同规模基线高 17.2 分。PCB 设计、芯片设计流程自动化和软件开发案例展示了其利用工具执行反馈进行多步规划、调试和迭代验证的能力。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点包括知识树驱动的数据飞轮、多专家模型训练与 MOPD 能力整合，以及面向工业工具的 Micius Harness。客观来看，其价值在于将领域数据构建、专家能力蒸馏和工具执行闭环结合，探索了工程智能体从数据到部署的系统化方案。

Abstract: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window. We design the Micius data pipeline as a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel comprising three stages: knowledge tree construction and expansion, data synthesis, and quality validation with hard-example augmentation. From this data, we train expert models for semiconductor knowledge and reasoning, hardware coding, and semiconductor multimodal understanding, along with agentic experts. Subsequently, we employ Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) to supervise training on sequences generated by Micius itself, thereby integrating the capabilities of these expert models into a unified model. On more than 20 datasets with about 15K records, Micius-Flash averages 64.2% on hardware code benchmarks, 15.0 points above a same-size baseline. It scores 62.4% on a semiconductor-specific agent benchmark, exceeding the same-size baseline by 17.2 points. We further develop Micius Harness for industrial applications, connecting the model to specialized tools, including EDA tools and KiCad, as well as execution environments. Case studies in PCB design, chip design workflow automation, and software development demonstrate the model’s ability to use tool execution feedback for multi-step planning, code debugging, and iterative verification. We release Micius as an open-source model to advance the development of agents for science and engineering.

[231] A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules cs.SE | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Jiantong Xu

TL;DR: 论文研究在自生成训练数据中，给定目标（target）的生成方式对小型推理模型学习新规则的影响：该 2B 参数推理模型学习两条虚构的定量规则，目标由规则表（仅给出规则）或规则表加程序编写的解答过程（worked solution）生成。结果显示，在练习操作上，两种方式的准确率相同，但仅用规则表生成的目标在组合复用（组合复用指跨两段顺序使用同一规则）上明显更好。论文据此指出，选择生成上下文时不能只看前向准确率，还要测试新规则如何被复用以及推理成本。

Details

Motivation: 带解答过程的训练目标更短、生成更便宜，但练习操作上的准确率可能掩盖模型能否真正复用新学到的规则。论文想弄清楚：在自生成训练数据中是否提供 worked solution，会如何影响规则的前向使用与跨段组合复用。

Result: 在两个独立采样的目标库对上，仅用规则表生成的目标在组合测试上领先 24.3 个百分点（95% CI 14.6–34.0）；在未见参数值上，两者的前向准确率均为 87.5%，但组合准确率分别为 58.3% 和 23.6%（差 34.7 点）；第二库对重复同一方向（+14.6 点）。改用较短 worked solution 目标并训练 10 轮后，差距缩小到 16.3 点，第二库对则为 6.2 点，但预设检验不成立（CI 含 0）。另外，训练后模型每取得一次组合成功所需生成的 token 数多出 2.6 倍。

Insight: 论文的创新之处在于，它揭示出练习准确率无法反映规则组合复用能力，并把数据生成成本与训练后推理成本一起纳入评估框架；同时也说明 worked solution 虽降低生成 token 与更新时间，却可能损害规则复用效率。

Abstract: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.

cs.SI [Back]

[232] Collaboration Signatures: Tracking Long-Horizon Dynamics of Cross-Meeting Collaboration Networks cs.SI | cs.CL | cs.CY | cs.HCPDF

Shengqi Zhu, Sheshera Mysore, Bahareh Sarrafzadeh

TL;DR: 论文提出通过追踪跨会议协作网络来理解长期动态。基于一家大型科技公司的45,426场会议（含完整转录和160万议程项），链接出6,065个协作，发现会议连接成树状结构、工作内容形成嵌套有向无环图。进一步提出“协作签名”——沿树累积议程、互动和语言——能有效识别协作（4.5倍于随机机会），并在下次会议预测和树级拟合中优于团队或任务视角。

Details

Motivation: 现有工作依赖邮件、聊天等碎片化日志，只关注谁与谁连接，忽略协作内容和动态，无法刻画长期工作场所协作的演化。论文旨在系统追踪跨会议序列，以理解协作的长期动态。

Result: 构建了包含6,065个协作的跨会议网络；协作签名在识别留出会议所属协作时达到4.5倍于随机机会的准确率，并在下次会议预测和树级拟合任务中优于任务划分、团队组成及其组合视角。

Insight: 创新点在于：1）基于完整转录和议程项链接会议，构建跨会议协作网络；2）发现协作网络呈现树状结构和嵌套DAG；3）提出协作签名，沿树累积多模态信息（议程、互动、语言）来刻画协作；4）实证签名优于传统团队/任务视角。客观分析：论文将协作视为长期动态过程，提供了新的表示方法，对办公工具和Web系统设计有启示。

Abstract: Enterprise platforms have received increasing attention as a core component of social networks and the Web. However, existing work mostly relies on fragmented logs of small units of work, like emails and chats, and focuses on who connects with whom without sufficient account of collaboration content and dynamics. This work systematically explores tracking collaborations across sequences of meetings as a new approach to interpreting their long-horizon dynamics. Linking 45,426 meetings in a large multinational technology company based on full transcripts and 1.6 million extracted agenda items, we establish a cross-meeting collaboration network of 6,065 collaborations. The network recovers the natural shapes of workplace collaborations: meetings, as snapshots of ongoing collaboration, link into largely tree-shaped structures, while the work content forms nested directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Further, we explore how these networks evolve over time, examining three established perspectives: task division, team composition, and temporal continuity. Each explains part of the dynamics but does not capture the distinctness of long-horizon workplace collaboration: e.g., work flows in a consistent direction between a few pairs of subjects, yet a collaboration’s subject explains little of how its meetings are conducted. Instead, accumulating the agenda, interaction, and language of meetings along each tree yields a signature of the collaboration, a distinctive profile that picks out the collaboration of a held-out meeting at 4.5 times chance. The signature models collaboration better than team or task views, individually or combined, in next-meeting prediction and tree-level fitting. We discuss the implications of these cross-meeting dynamics for designing office applications and support tools, and call for next-generation Web systems that represent collaborations over their long horizon.

[233] Covariate-Conditioned One-Step Diffusion for Multi-Horizon 3D Brain MRI Prediction in Aging and Neurodegeneration eess.IV | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Natenaile Asmamaw Shiferaw, Ali Farki, Deepika Koundal, Jussi Tohka

TL;DR: 论文提出一种协变量条件的一步扩散框架，用于多时间跨度预测3D灰质密度（GMD）图。模型不直接生成未来解剖，而是单步去噪预测纵向GMD残差变化，再叠加到基线GMD上重建未来结构；统一模型支持2至10年预测，并在ADNI与AIBL上验证。

Details

Motivation: 基于MRI预测纵向脑结构变化有助于刻画老化与神经退行性进展，但扩散模型通常需要迭代去噪，推理效率低。论文旨在实现高效且可条件化的多horizon 3D脑MRI预测。

Result: 在ADNI留出测试集上达到Δ-Pearson 0.478、MSE 5.176e-3、SSIM 0.979，10年Δ-Pearson为0.582；不重新训练在AIBL外部评估达到Δ-Pearson 0.450、MSE 4.016e-3、SSIM 0.985。消融实验验证了残差预测、协变量条件和相关性监督的有效性。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新在于一步扩散、残差预测与协变量条件结合，实现统一多horizon预测。客观来看，其创新点在于将高效单步扩散用于纵向变化建模，并融合基线解剖、年龄、诊断、APOE4和随访时间等条件，同时用Pearson相关损失提升变化空间一致性，且具备外部数据泛化验证。

Abstract: Predicting longitudinal brain changes from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can help characterize structural progression associated with aging and neurodegeneration. However, diffusion-based forecasting typically requires iterative denoising, limiting inference efficiency. We propose a covariate-conditioned one-step diffusion framework for multi-horizon prediction of 3D gray-matter density (GMD) maps. Rather than directly generating future anatomy, the model predicts longitudinal GMD changes through residual prediction in a single denoising step. The predicted changes are added to the baseline GMD map to reconstruct future anatomy. The model is conditioned on baseline anatomy, age, diagnosis, APOE4 allele count, and continuous follow-up time. Training combines mean squared error with a Pearson correlation loss to improve the spatial agreement between predicted and observed GMD changes. A unified model supports prediction horizons from 2 to 10 years. On the held-out ADNI test set, our method achieves a $Δ$-Pearson of 0.478, mean squared error (MSE) of $5.176 \times 10^{-3}$, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.979, with $Δ$-Pearson reaching 0.582 at 10 years. Without retraining, external evaluation on AIBL yields a $Δ$-Pearson of 0.450, MSE of $4.016 \times 10^{-3}$, and SSIM of 0.985. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of residual prediction, covariate conditioning, and correlation-based supervision. Code: https://github.com/natenaile/OneStepBrainMRI.

[234] Frequency-consistent synthesis and selective transfer for medical image analysis eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Zhuhui Wang, Jianwei Zuo, Xin Peng, Kai Zhong, Xuliang Deng

TL;DR: 论文提出一种将医学图像合成与下游任务学习耦合的训练框架，通过自适应频率一致性和选择性特征迁移，使合成图像更有利于后续分析。在五个数据集上验证了该方法可提升无配对监督下对抗与扩散翻译器的保真度，并在脑肿瘤分割和病灶中心点检测上取得增益，105组配对比较均倾向支持所提方法。

Details

Motivation: 互补医学影像并非总是可获得，而合成图像视觉上更真实并不必然提升下游任务性能，因此需要让图像合成直接服务于任务学习。

Result: 在五个数据集上，三种无配对监督的对抗和扩散翻译器取得更高翻译保真度；含肿瘤切片的脑肿瘤分割和病灶中心点检测均有增益；全部105组配对比较的点估计均支持所提方法，包括36组无需重训练的治疗后MRI外部翻译比较。

Insight: 创新点在于用图像特定的自适应频率约束保持结构与细节一致性，并基于任务误差边际进行选择性特征迁移，仅当合成图像教师优于学生时才迁移特征；客观看，其亮点是合成与下游任务联动及避免负迁移的选择机制。

Abstract: Complementary imaging is not always available, and realistic synthesis does not necessarily improve downstream analysis. Here we introduce a training framework linking medical image synthesis to task learning through adaptive frequency consistency and selective feature transfer. Image-specific frequency constraints encourage consistency of structure and detail. Features are transferred only when a teacher using synthetic images achieves a lower task-error score than the student by a task-specific margin on a labelled training sample. Evaluations across five datasets show improved translation fidelity with three adversarial and diffusion-based translators trained without paired supervision, alongside gains in brain-tumour segmentation on tumour-containing slices and lesion centre-point detection. All 105 reported paired comparisons yielded point estimates favouring the proposed methods, including 36 external translation comparisons on post?treatment MRI without retraining. These findings support synthetic modalities as task-oriented complements to acquired scans when complementary imaging is unavailable.
